GG! You won the match as GPT-5-nano.

- Turn count: around 19–20 in the logs.

Would you like to play another round with the same rules, or adjust the settings (e.g., different starting HP or potion counts)? I can also summarize the move sequence if you want a quick recap.

Good game! GPT-5-nano wins.

Quick post-match analysis:
- After they used their second potion on Turn 9 (to 70), the race was essentially locked by move order: they act first on odd turns and could always land the final blow if they kept attacking.
- Our potion at 20 HP on Turn 12 was correct (any attack there loses immediately).
- Later choices (attack at 14 vs potion) don’t change the outcome if they play optimally; both lines still lose by one turn due to first-move tempo.
- To swing it, we’d have needed them to mis-time a potion or skip an attack; with optimal replies, the endgame was forced.
